text.title: user-flows.md Template Procedure
text.summary: Seven steps: decide whether the artefact is required, then write one block per flow — actor, preconditions, numbered happy path, negative paths with trigger and expected UX, Playwright spec path — and gate on pos+neg before readiness.md item 6.

step.name: decide-applicability
step.input: The feature's spec and the surfaces it touches.
step.action: Ask whether the user takes a sequence of actions: page navigation, form submission, button click, command invocation. Backend API endpoint with no UI consumer in this feature → API tests only. Background worker / job / cron → unit + integration tests. Data migration → migration test + reversibility check.
step.decision-gate: Skipped — do not create user-flows.md; the work verifies in `tests/api/`. Stop.

step.name: instantiate-template
step.action: Copy the fillable template into `features/in-progress/F0NN-slug/user-flows.md`. It carries one-flow stub with the five fields.
step.output: user-flows.md skeleton in the feature directory.

step.name: enumerate-flows
step.action: One block per user-facing flow, headed `## Flow F-0N: <one-line flow title>`. Repeat the shape per flow.

step.name: actor-and-preconditions
step.action: Actor — who is doing the flow (anonymous user, signed-in solo-tier user, admin). Preconditions — what state the system must be in (account exists, payment method on file).

step.name: happy-path
step.action: Numbered steps + expected result per step. The success criterion is in the final step.

step.name: negative-paths
step.input: Each flow; the unsexy-edge list in 05-examples.xml.
step.action: At least one negative path. Each: trigger (what causes the error), expected error UX (what the user sees, where). When there is time for only one extra test, write the negative one — authentication failure, network drop, invalid input, race condition, double-submit are where regressions live.
step.decision-gate: A flow with zero negatives does not pass; three positives do not substitute for one negative.

step.name: spec-path-and-gate
step.action: Playwright spec path — relative path to the spec file that automates this flow, 1:1. Validate the file against 02-output-contract.xml. Then the reviewer ticks readiness.md item 6 (Playwright pos+neg) with the spec results as evidence.
step.output: user-flows.md passing the contract; readiness.md item 6 ticked.
step.decision-gate: Missing fields fail the readiness gate — fix before item 6 is ticked.

list.item: user-flows.md validates against the schema in 02-output-contract.xml
Every flow has five fields, at least one positive and one negative case, and one spec file
No failure mode from 03-failure-modes.xml is present
